title: Here’s How Trump’s White House Press Ban Hurts MAGA Media Too
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In tonight's edition, Donald Trump's press ban on
CNN, MS NOW, and _Politico_ was challenged in court this afternoon, where the
judge didn't seem to buy the administration's ad hoc "national security"
justification for barring the outlets. With the court almost certainly set to
order the White House to restore the outlets' access on due process grounds, I
look at how this authoritarian ban has actually been bad for right-wing media.
Plus, despite a blockbuster interview, '60 Minutes' continues to be Bari'd,
and all the latest from the WarnerMount merger.

When a Newsmax anchor admitted this week that **Donald Trump 's** press ban
was "backfiring just a little bit," [many took
it](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-news/trump-free-press-ban-
blows-up-1235629694/) as the president [finally being
deprived](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/21/us/politics/trump-television-
reporters-cameras.html?utm_source=cnn_Reliable+Sources&utm_medium=email) of
that sweet narcotic of television coverage, which is what he craves more than
oxygen itself.

And while that is certainly true, what quickly became apparent is that Trump
barring CNN, MS NOW and _Politico_ from the White House was also hurting the
MAGA media landscape to the point that they desperately needed this ban to be
reversed in short order.
